column1: # Perf budget ceilings for the native-free host benchmarks, checked as a ratio
# of this PR's median over master's, both run on the one CI runner in the one
# follow-up sets WS_PERF_BUDGET_ENFORCE=1, once the CI runs show the spread.
# ceiling_ratio: the most head/base may be before the gate fails. Set well
#   above run-to-run noise (measured ~7% for the url-change median, wider for
#   startup's end-to-end marks), so only a real regression clears it.
# floor_ms: a base median below this is near-zero work whose ratio is noise;
#   it is reported, not gated. Raise a ceiling here, never shorten a benchmark.
